call_memory.statement: In the 23% revenue growth guidance, the calendarization impact of past acquisitions accounts for around 11% and the rest is organic.

call_memory.statement: Entero generates approximately INR 10 crores to INR 12 crores of GLP-1 sales per month, representing roughly 5% of overall industry value.

lab.quote: The same that we have always said before, which is 5 to 7x of enterprise value to EBITDA.

call_memory.quote: The same that we have always said before, which is 5 to 7x of enterprise value to EBITDA.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Acquisitions are typically valued at 5x to 7x enterprise value to EBITDA.

timeline.summary: On April 17, 2026, the Ministry of Corporate Affairs approved the fast-track amalgamation of Chethana Pharma Distributors and CPD Pharma into Rada Medisolutions with effect from April 15, 2025.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,909.93 Cr (+42.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹28.01 Cr (+9.0% YoY).
Entero Healthcare reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹6,591.2 Cr, up 29.3% YoY, with EBITDA margin expanding to 4.0%.
Entero Healthcare uploaded the audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 26, 2026, with transcript to follow.
Entero Healthcare hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 26, 2026, guiding for 23% revenue growth in FY27.
Prem Sethi, promoter of Entero Healthcare Solutions Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares during FY2026 ended March 31, 2026.

watchlist.response: Attributed to abnormal pre-poned sales in a subsidiary during Q4 which will normalise, with minority interest expected to reduce to 25-27% of pre-minority PAT next year.
watchlist.text: High minority interest impact in Q4 FY26 and sustainability of finance costs.
